steps.text: The faster something moves, the more distance it covers in the same time. Let's race and see.
Tap “Start Race!” and watch the racers.
The fastest racer reaches the finish first because it covers more distance each second — higher speed.
Same distance, less time = higher speed. That's what winning the race shows: greater speed means less time to cover the track.

coach.mission: Race the runners and see how speed decides the winner.
whenStuck: Tap “Start Race!” and watch which racer finishes first.
Think about who covers more distance each second.
whenWrong: The faster racer covers more distance per second, so it wins.
For the same distance, higher speed means less time.
whenCorrect: Right — the fastest racer covered the distance in the least time.
Good — more speed, less time for the same distance.
coach.done: You've seen how speed decides a race. Race again, or move on when you're ready.
